name: Lucky Dragon Hibachi
facts: Lucky Dragon Hibachi is in Compton, California.
Hours: Mon–Thu 11:00a–9:00p, Fri–Sat 11:00a–10:00p, Sun 12:00p–8:00p.

qa.a: Mon–Thu 11:00a–9:00p, Fri–Sat 11:00a–10:00p, and Sun 12:00p–8:00p.
We're open every day: Mon–Thu 11a–9p, Fri–Sat 11a–10p, Sun 12p–8p. For holiday changes, call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: What time do you open on Sunday?
qa.a: Sundays we're open 12:00p to 8:00p.

qa.q: What time do you close on Friday and Saturday?
qa.a: We close at 10:00p on Fridays and Saturdays.

qa.q: What time do you close Monday to Thursday?
qa.a: Monday through Thursday we close at 9:00p.
We're in Compton, California. The exact street address isn't in the app yet, so tap Directions to open the map or call 562-564-9200.
Tap the Directions button in the app. It opens Lucky Dragon Hibachi in Google Maps.
Call us at 562-564-9200. You can tap Call to order in the app.
Tap Call to order in the app, or call 562-564-9200. The app also has a Build your plate tool to put together a hibachi plate.

qa.q: Can I order from my table with a QR code?
qa.a: I don't have details on table QR ordering. Please ask staff or call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: Can I pay in the app?
qa.a: I don't have any in-app payment details. Please ask staff or call 562-564-9200.
I don't have parking details. Please call 562-564-9200 and we'll help.
I don't have reservation info. Please call 562-564-9200.
Hibachi Chicken, Steak, Shrimp, a Chicken + Shrimp Combo and Premium Lobster. Sides include Fried Rice, Noodles and Extra Yum-Yum.

qa.q: What does the Hibachi Chicken come with?
qa.a: Grilled chicken, fried rice, veggies and house yum-yum sauce.

qa.q: What does the Hibachi Steak come with?
qa.a: Sirloin, fried rice, veggies and double yum-yum.

qa.q: What does the Hibachi Shrimp come with?
qa.a: Jumbo shrimp, fried rice and veggies.

qa.q: What is the Chicken + Shrimp Combo?
qa.a: It's a hibachi combo of chicken and shrimp. It's the one from the review video.
Yes, Premium Lobster, grilled hibachi style. You can add it to any meal. It's market price (MP), so ask staff for today's price.
Fried Rice (wok-fired with egg and scallion), garlic butter hibachi Noodles, and Extra Yum-Yum.

The app lists sample prices: Chicken $12.95, Steak $15.95, Shrimp $14.95, Chicken + Shrimp Combo $16.95, Fried Rice $6.50, Noodles $6.95, Extra Yum-Yum $1.00. Lobster is market price. Menu prices in the app are samples, so confirm with staff.
Premium Lobster is market price (MP). Ask staff or call 562-564-9200 for today's price.
It's our house sauce that comes with hibachi plates. Extra Yum-Yum is $1.00 per the app's sample menu.

qa.q: Can I build my own plate?
qa.a: Yes. The app's Build your plate tool lets you pick a base (fried rice, chow mein or half & half), proteins and extras. You watch the price add up, then place the order.

qa.q: What proteins can I add when building a plate?
qa.a: Chicken, Steak, Shrimp, Salmon and Scallops. You can add up to 2 each of chicken, steak and shrimp, and 1 each of salmon and scallops.

qa.q: What are the prices in the plate builder?
qa.a: Bases: Fried rice $6.50, Chow mein $6.95, Half & half $7.50. Proteins: Chicken $6.45, Steak $9.45, Shrimp $8.45, Salmon $9.95, Scallops $10.95. Hibachi veggies are free and Yum-yum is $1.00. These are the app's sample prices.
The game shows house drinks, but I don't have a drink menu. Ask staff or call 562-564-9200.
I don't have info on that. Ask staff. No app prize ever includes alcohol.
I don't have a confirmed list of specials right now. Check the app for any special banner or ask staff.
I don't have any happy hour info. Please ask staff or call 562-564-9200.
It's our 30-second arcade game. Slide your tray to catch hibachi food and dodge flames, candy, ice and the dragon's fire.

qa.q: How do I play Hibachi Catch?
qa.a: Tap to start, then slide your finger left and right to move the tray. Catch the food, dodge the bad stuff and watch out for the dragon.
Each run is 30 seconds, or less if the dragon hits you 3 times.
Slide your finger across the game to move the tray. With a game controller, use the stick or D-pad to slide the tray.

qa.q: Does it cost anything to play?
qa.a: No. Hibachi Catch is free and no purchase is necessary.

qa.q: Do I need an account to play?
qa.a: No. Anyone can play as often as they like without an account. You need a free account only to save your score or claim a prize.
As often as you like. The game is free with no daily limit.
Catch chicken, steak, shrimp, lobster, veggies, chow mein, fried rice and drinks. Each is worth +10 points.

qa.q: How many points is each item worth?
qa.a: Food and drinks are +10 each. A Gold Star is +50. Flame, candy and ice are −20 each. Dragon fire is −30.
A rare pickup worth +50 points that also keeps your streak going.
Catch in a row without a miss and you get +2 extra per catch, up to +10 extra. At a 5+ streak that's +20 a catch.
Dodge flames, candy and ice. Each one costs −20 and resets your streak.
The dragon locks on to your tray, shown by a dashed red line, then breathes fire. Move out of the way or you lose 30 points and your streak.
Your food is burnt and the run ends. Each hit also toasts your rice darker.

qa.q: What is the lantern in the game?
qa.a: A paper lantern drifts down once per run. Catch it on your tray for a +300 bonus and a link to Antidote The Foodie's review of Lucky Dragon.

qa.q: What can I win from the game?
qa.a: One run of 650+ points earns 15% off your next meal and a spot on the weekly board. 1st place on the weekly board wins 50% off your next meal and 2nd wins 20% off. The app labels these prizes as sample, so confirm with staff.

qa.q: How does the weekly leaderboard work?
qa.a: The highest score from Monday through Sunday close wins. Ties go to the score posted first. The board resets every Monday.

qa.q: When does the weekly board reset?
qa.a: Every Monday, with new winners each week.

qa.q: How do I claim my game prize?
qa.a: Finish a run, then save your score with a free account (name, phone, email). Winners may be asked to show the code on their phone and a matching account at the counter.
650 points or more in a single run.
The player with the highest score on the weekly board, Monday through Sunday close.
The board runs Monday through Sunday close and resets Monday. I don't have a more exact pick-up time, so ask staff.

qa.q: Do I need to buy food to win?
qa.a: No. No purchase of any kind is needed to play or win, and buying doesn't improve your chances.

qa.q: Is the game skill or luck?
qa.a: Skill. Game prizes depend only on your score and your rank on the weekly board.

qa.q: Can I cheat or use bots?
qa.a: No. Scores made with cheats, scripts, bots or multiple accounts are disqualified.
A free daily wheel for members. Every slice wins something: points, a discount or a free food item.
Once per member per day, based on Los Angeles time.

qa.q: What can I win on the spin?
qa.a: +50, +75 or +100 reward points, $2 off a hibachi plate, free extra Yum-Yum, a free side of fried rice, or 10% off your order.

qa.q: What are the odds on the spin?
qa.a: +50 pts 30%, +100 pts 20%, +75 pts 15%, $2 off a plate 15%, free Yum-Yum 8%, free fried rice 7%, 10% off your order 5%.

qa.q: How long do spin prizes last?
qa.a: Food prizes and discounts are good for 3 days at the Compton location. They are one reward per visit, can't be combined with other rewards, have no cash value and can't be transferred.
No. The spin is always free. It's never sold and can't be earned by buying anything.

qa.q: How do I join the rewards program?
qa.a: Sign up free with your name, phone number and email. You can do it after a game run or from the join card in the app.
U.S. residents age 13 or older. Under 18 needs a parent's or guardian's permission. It's one account per person and per phone.
Yes: Free Extra Yum-Yum plus 10% off your next plate when you join.
You earn points from the Daily Spin and from purchases. I don't have the exact points-per-dollar ratio, so ask staff.

qa.q: How many points do I get per dollar?
qa.a: I don't have that number. Ask staff or call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: How many points do I get per visit?
qa.a: I don't have a per-visit point value. Ask staff or call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: What rewards can I get with points?
qa.a: 250 pts: Free extra Yum-Yum. 500 pts: Free fried rice. 800 pts: Free hibachi plate. 1,300 pts: Dinner for two.

qa.q: How do I redeem my points?
qa.a: Open your rewards card in the app and pick a reward you have enough points for. Show it at the counter. Ask staff if you're unsure.

qa.q: Do points expire or have cash value?
qa.a: Points have no cash value. I don't have expiration info, so ask staff.

qa.q: Do you have levels or tiers?
qa.a: I don't have confirmed level details for Lucky Dragon. Ask staff.
I don't have birthday club details. Ask staff or call 562-564-9200.
Yes, there's a referral program with a Free fried rice gift. I don't have the exact steps, so ask staff.

qa.q: Is there a bonus for showing up?
qa.a: Showing the app at the counter may earn double stars on that day's order. Ask staff to confirm.
Not right now. Hibachi Catch is free to play. If tokens are turned on later, a play would cost 10 tokens with free ways to get them.
After about 90 seconds of total play, a short break plays Antidote The Foodie's review of Lucky Dragon. You can skip it or watch the full review on YouTube.

qa.q: Is there trivia or a sports feature?
qa.a: I don't have trivia or sports features listed for Lucky Dragon.
There's no separate kid mode. Players under 18 need a parent's or guardian's permission for an account.

qa.q: What languages does the app support?
qa.a: Use the 🌐 menu for English, Spanish, Chinese (simplified and traditional), Korean, Tagalog, Vietnamese, Armenian, Persian, Japanese, Thai and Russian.

qa.q: How do I add the app to my phone?
qa.a: Use Add to Home Screen in the game menu or the page footer. On iPhone use Share, then Add to Home Screen. On Android use Install app or the ⋮ menu.
I don't have wallet card info. You can add the app to your Home Screen, though.
Your info is used only for your rewards account and is never sold. Opt-in texts and emails can be stopped by replying STOP or unsubscribing.
Only if you opt in. You can stop texts or emails anytime by replying STOP or unsubscribing.
Employees and their household members may play but can't win prizes.

qa.q: Where can I read the official rules?
qa.a: The app has an Official Rules link under the game. The rules are marked as a draft, so ask staff if you have questions.

qa.q: Can I use a rewards code with other discounts?
qa.a: Food prizes and discounts can't be combined with other rewards, and it's one reward per visit.

qa.q: Do you have a social media page?
qa.a: Yes, follow us on Instagram at @luckydragon360. Posts and reels show in the app too.
Yes, the app has a Google review button. Reviews earn no points or prizes, and honest reviews are welcome.

qa.q: How do I get help from staff?
qa.a: Call 562-564-9200 or ask at the counter.

qa.q: I have a problem with my prize or points. Who do I ask?
qa.a: Call 562-564-9200 or ask staff at the counter. Have the code on your phone ready.
